cell_type_model: SH-SY5Y human neuroblastoma cells; human lung adenocarcinoma cells; mouse lung-tumor models

limitations: The submitted ligand and receptor are composite entities; the strongest direct receptor-complex and pSTAT evidence is in engineered or tumor-cell contexts, and the studies do not establish an SCI-specific receiver state. limitations: The receptor is the alpha11beta1 heterodimer although the submitted label contains ITGA11 alone; the intracellular integrin relay is functionally inferred from receptor loss and Wnt readouts rather than a single defined adaptor chain, and no terminal TF was assigned.

cell_type_model: mouse and human platelets; lymphatic endothelial cells; podoplanin-expressing tumor cells; 293T and CHO transfectants

cell_type_model: mouse primary liver sinusoidal endothelial cells and differentiated Th17 cells; cirrhotic mouse liver; human cirrhotic liver samples

cell_type_model: mouse oligodendrocyte precursor cells and glial populations; primary tectal neurons; COS7 and neuroblastoma models

cell_type_model: primary mouse dorsal-root-ganglion neurons and growth cones; COS7 cells transfected with TAG1/CNTN2, NRP1 and L1; mouse Cntn2 perturbation models

cell_type_model: HEK293 and HEK293F transfectants; mouse rod photoreceptor outer segments; purified PTPRG and CNTN3 ectodomains

cell_type_model: HEK293 transfectants; purified PTPRG/CNTN4 ectodomains; neuronal and retinal comparator systems

relation_type: PTPRG directly binds CNTN4 through its extracellular carbonic-anhydrase-like domain
pathway_branch: CNTN4 -> PTPRG ectodomain complex; no exact-pair intracellular phosphatase readout or terminal functional output was demonstrated

cell_type_model: ES2 human ovarian cancer cells; ovarian-cancer xenograft models; recombinant full-length COL11A1 systems

limitations: The study defines an adhesion/transmigration mechanism rather than a detailed intracellular kinase cascade; the exact collagen-XIII binding site is mapped but the downstream monocyte signaling intermediates and SCI relevance remain unresolved.

cell_type_model: bovine pulmonary arterial endothelial cells; NIH3T3 cells expressing glypican-1; renal epithelial/ureteric-bud models
assay_or_perturbation: Alkaline-phosphatase-tagged endostatin binding; expression cloning; Scatchard analysis; glypican-1 antisense perturbation; VEGF-induced endothelial migration and renal branching assays

limitations: The active ligand is the proteolytic endostatin domain, not intact full-length collagen XVIII; binding is largely glycan-mediated and the high-affinity signaling receptor remains unidentified, so no direct intracellular relay or terminal TF was assigned.

cell_type_model: NIH3T3 cells expressing glypican-4; renal tubular/ureteric-bud epithelial models; endothelial comparator systems
assay_or_perturbation: Alkaline-phosphatase-tagged endostatin binding to glypican-4-expressing cells; Scatchard analysis; glypican-4 antisense and morphogenesis assays

pathway_branch: COL18A1/endostatin -> GPC4 heparan-sulfate coreceptor -> higher-affinity endothelial/epithelial receptor not identified -> anti-migratory or branching-morphogenesis output
limitations: The exact GPC4 evidence is expression-cloning and glycan-dependent; the high-affinity signaling receptor is unknown and most functional evidence is epithelial/endothelial rather than an intracellular GPC4 relay, so no terminal TF was assigned.

cell_type_model: human endothelial cells/HUVECs; recombinant endostatin and purified alpha5beta1; endothelial lipid-raft and caveolin-1 systems
assay_or_perturbation: Endostatin binding and integrin clustering; alpha5beta1/caveolin-1 colocalization; tyrosine-phosphatase and Src perturbation; endothelial adhesion and cytoskeletal assays
relation_type: The endostatin domain of COL18A1 associates with alpha5beta1 integrin and caveolin-1 and activates a Src-linked receptor-proximal branch affecting endothelial cytoskeletal organization

limitations: The study tests the proteolytic endostatin fragment and reports integrin/caveolin association rather than intact collagen XVIII as a ligand; integrin subtype and soluble versus immobilized ligand alter the response, and no terminal TF was assigned.

cell_type_model: primary human umbilical-vein endothelial cells; purified KDR/Flk-1 ectodomain; recombinant mouse endostatin
assay_or_perturbation: Endostatin affinity chromatography; KDR-Fc/VEGF binding competition; VEGF stimulation with endostatin pretreatment; KDR phosphorylation, ERK, p38, FAK, proliferation and migration assays

pathway_branch: COL18A1/endostatin -> KDR/VEGFR2 -> inhibition of VEGF-induced receptor phosphorylation, ERK/p38/FAK signaling -> reduced endothelial proliferation and migration
limitations: The active ligand is endostatin rather than full-length collagen XVIII and the effect is antagonistic rather than an activating KDR ligand response; the study does not define the exact KDR interface or a terminal TF.

cell_type_model: HEK293 cells expressing DDR1; human cancer-cell models; recombinant collagen I and DDR1 ectodomains
assay_or_perturbation: Collagen-I/DDR1 binding and fibrillogenesis assays; collagen stimulation; DDR1 mutant and trans-dimerization studies; receptor tyrosine phosphorylation; DDR1 knockdown and gamma-secretase inhibition; Notch1 nuclear activation assays
relation_type: Collagen I directly binds and activates the DDR1 receptor tyrosine kinase through receptor clustering and inter-dimer phosphorylation, with a cancer-cell prosurvival branch involving Notch1
